name: Shore
author: Erin Carter
description: A single quadratic Julia coastline glows between two near-black domains: smooth escape bands hug the boundary and compress into self-similar filigree at every cape and inlet, while a hidden seed creeping along the Mandelbrot cardioid makes the whole frontier writhe into ever-different coastlines.

params.label: Writhe speed
params.effect: How fast the hidden seed creeps along the cardioid, i.e. how quickly the coastline becomes a different coastline (0 freezes a single coastline, still fully drawn).

params.label: Zoom
params.effect: Magnification of the complex plane about frame centre — low values show the whole island chain, high values fill the frame with one stretch of coast.

params.label: Glow reach
params.effect: How many escape bands stay luminous before fading to black, widening or tightening the glowing margin around the coastline.

params.label: Phase spread
params.effect: How quickly the four palette colours cycle across successive escape bands, from broad single-hue washes to fine multi-hue lamination.
